Then gather case IDs, then call briefs_display_cases with combined list? But limit 5 per location? The user wants top 5 relevant cases overall. We'll search each location separately, get up to 5 each, combine, then pick top 5? But we don't have relevance ranking. We'll just take first 5 from each, combine, then pass all to briefs_display_cases? That might exceed limit. But briefs_display_cases doesn't have limit param. It will display all briefs.
